_readme: Index for the coding home page. Each problems-N.json holds at most 'limit' (100) problems. To add a problem: append it to the newest problems-N.json (when that file has 100, create problems-(N+1).json and add it to 'chunks'), then update totalProblems, difficultyCounts, that chunk's count/lastId, and bump 'version' so browsers re-download the changed files. The 'file' value must be lowercase letters, digits and hyphens ending in .html.
